title: Infected! (Immersion RPG system)
author: Oliver R. Shead
url: https://www.immersion-rpg.com/ (per sampler p.3: 'order a PDF copy of the book on Drive Thru RPG, search for Infected Zombie RPG') — exact DriveThruRPG listing URL not independently verified this run
licence_note: Third-party commercial RPG PDFs. original.pdf, narrator-screen.pdf and lobster-problems.pdf are NOT committed to the repo (gitignored) per project policy — quoted excerpts only, in source.md and the vault note.
game_type_determination: CONFIRMED TABLETOP RPG, not a miniatures wargame. Sampler p.4 states outright: 'Welcome to Infected!, a tabletop role playing game — also called an RPG.' Character build uses Attributes/Skills/Circumstances/Advantages-Disadvantages purchased with Experience, a Narrator (GM) sets scenes, and 'combat' resolves via the same 1D10+Attribute / 1D10+Skill dice-pool check as every other action — there is no miniatures/basing/measured-movement layer of any kind anywhere in the 66 pages read.

files_captured.description: Second-edition sampler/quickstart PDF — preview of the full rulebook, funded via 2015 Kickstarter, printed mid-2016. Covers the core dice mechanic, Attributes/Skills/Circumstances, Health/Morality, Hardness Rating (armour vs weapon tiers), a short combat-sequence walkthrough, five pre-gen NPCs, and one full sample scenario ('The Fifty Hands').

Back face of the official GM/Narrator screen — labelled 'Core' (i.e. drawn from the full published rulebook, not the sampler). Dense single-page reference: weapon/armour quick-reference, Hardness Rating table, combat sequence, targeted-strike table, bungle-result table, random NPC generator, gradients of success. Highest information density of the three files.

Published adventure/scenario module (1-4 players, 4-6hr). Pure narrative scene-setting and NPC dialogue for a Narrator to run — no new mechanics, no infection/noise/scavenging rules beyond flavour text. References 'page 188 of the Infected Rulebook' for full setting detail, confirming a much larger core book exists that we do not have.

not_captured.reason: Not provided as a working copy for this run. Likely player-facing charts (Attribute/Skill lists, statistic-level ladder) mirroring content already in the sampler. Lower priority than the Back face per the task brief; not fetched or read.
